author: Kazo OS
name: Kazo OS drive provider
description: A Kazo OS Feature that provides a type of network drive (ADR 0282): the provider over a web API reached with KazoDirectHttpClient, its declaration, and the public conformance suite run against an in-memory service.

appId.description: Feature id (reverse-DNS, lowercase), unique in the catalog.

publisherId.description: Publisher id written in the manifest.

driveType.description: The filesystem type of the drives, as mount -t shows it: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

apiHost.description: The host of the service's API, reached over https; it must accept CORS from the OS page.
